E120-I01.source: text_edit_session.cj:105–137 publishes text/token/revisions/history before signalPending; editing-source getter uses sync(deferSignal:true); text_editing.cj:133–142 installs the sole framework-owned afterEvaluate handler. binding.cj:55–58 invokes it only after track succeeds; trackSeeded restores the evaluation guard at86–88, completes subscriptions89–91, and releases ownerLock92–99 before returning.
E120-I01.ordering: If a consumer was already evaluated, signal.notify queues it again with committed state; if later in the ready batch, it sees committed state. Same-version sync returns without a new signal, so the added pass stabilizes. Snapshot remains a query. Getter failure skips the hook and propagates to existing runtime failure cleanup. The hook calls only signal invalidation, not user code. Disposal and intrinsic owner clearing remain unchanged; no hook is invoked by dispose.

Both measure and draw choose committed edit state when mounted, otherwise read/validate the Observable and draw with TextSelection(0,0). All text/selection/LF/caret painting remains in the same Canvas callback. No intrinsic mount or controller attachment is added to temporary Runtime.

E120-I03.source: text_edit_session.cj:525–533 performs the expected-version history commit, returns unchanged on failure, then clears preferredColumn before publishing the restored source/text/selection and changed()/onChange. Both undo and redo use this single history method.

E120-I04.source: handle300–301 syncs once and captures expectedVersion. Text/paste and TextArea Enter carry it through keyboardInput304/316→replace297; deletion computes its range against the same local state and passes preparedVersion405. In replace151–153, prepared callers bypass the source-refresh branch154–165. No callback/pump/local synchronization runs between captured state and candidate calculation; permitted background writes alter only Observable. commit224 passes the captured version to the unchanged sole-lock conditional write.
E120-I04.old_counterexample: After handle reads ax/v, a worker sets YZ/v+1. The fix still calculates the old deletion result x, but editingCommit(v,x) sees v+1 and returns None; commit then syncs latest YZ and emits the sole ConcurrentValueChanged. It cannot change expectedVersion to v+1 or commit Z as the old implementation did.
E120-I04.rejection_and_noop: Keyboard control/multiline/byte prevalidation uses the same frozen local text/selection and rejection returns before candidate publication; replace does not resync to a larger value after size validation. Same-text prepared/guarded paths check actual source version before selection-only publication; a mismatch returns false (prepared path synchronizes the external value) without applying the old selection, no text write/history/onChange. Guarded controller replacements retain normal identity/revision/actual-source checks. No implicit retry is added.
E120-I04.race_attribution: Only text_edit_session145 emits ConcurrentValueChanged, following editingCommit(expectedVersion,next)==None. Observable.cj lock/value/version/atomic snapshot and conditional helper are unchanged. Actual fix1-editing output has both original conflict and I04 selector conflict with zero edits, finalYZ and no history. These establish observed conflicts, not which internal pre-commit interval was hit.
E120-I04.limitation: The specific early planning window is not forced by the public fixture. Closure of that source-proven original finding rests on the explicit version/data-flow proof above; no exact-window execution is claimed.
